title: Call for Speakers - February 9 Deadline!
description: Archived call for talks for the May 2015 OpenStack Summit in Vancouver, with the historical February 9 submission deadline.
body:
Would you like to speak at the May 2015 OpenStack Summit in Vancouver?

Then hurry up and submit a talk! February 9 is the final day that speaking submissions will be accepted.

SUBMIT YOUR TALK HERE!
seoTitle: OpenStack Vancouver 2015 — Call for Speakers - February 9 Deadline!
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
